retrieval.privacy: Searches run on your device; only relevant excerpts are sent to AI (not full files).
retrieval.empty: No matching excerpts in your library. Add documents or rephrase your question.

mockHint: Type "web" to demo web sources. Other messages use local RAG (Phase 9: Gemini gateway).
clearHistoryBody: This permanently removes all chat sessions on this device.
gatewayOffline: Gateway is offline. Start the dev gateway or check Settings.
gatewayOfflineChat: Chat is unavailable while the gateway is offline. Library and local search still work on your device.
saveWebBody: Index "{{title}}" locally so future questions can use it on-device.
saveWebDone: Web summary saved and indexing started
